verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS monitoring platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The agent-tracing docs cover observing the user's own agents, and the 'your agent will set up Sentry' note describes agent-assisted SDK setup; neither is an MCP server agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
